meta.description: Four sentence-continuation experiments in German on stimulus-experiencer and experiencer-stimulus verbs. Experiment 1 (52 participants): the referent of continuations after weil 'because' and sodass 'and so'. Experiment 2 (the same participants): the discourse relation and the referent of continuations after a full stop. Experiment 3 (64 participants): the discourse relation of continuations after a full stop that had to be about a marked argument. Experiment 4 (56 participants): the type of explanation or consequence after a connective and a pronoun congruent or incongruent with the connective's bias. The verb gefallen 'appeal to' is excluded throughout.
